description: Implementation of log file handling functions for Windows platform, including opening, closing, and writing to log files with thread safety.

methods.name: CloseLogFile
methods.description: Closes the log file safely with mutex locking.

methods.name: OpenLogInCacheDirectory
methods.description: Constructs log file path in cache directory and opens the log file.

methods.name: OpenLogFile
methods.description: Opens a log file at specified path with given creation flags, with thread safety.

methods.name: WriteToLogFile
methods.description: Writes text to the log file with thread safety and verifies write success.
